system.name: Pheromone
system.one_liner: a serverless function orchestration system built atop Cloudburst that follows the data instead of the function

components.name: Coordinator
components.role: cross-connects to worker node schedulers, coordinating function orchestration

components.name: Worker Node
components.role: runs schedulers, executors and a local object store

components.name: Scheduler
components.role: gives instructions to executors on a worker node

components.name: Executor
components.role: loads and executes user function code

components.name: Shared Memory Object Store
components.role: holds intermediate data generated by functions on a worker node

components.name: Durable Key-Value Store
components.role: durable storage shared across worker nodes

flows.what: intermediate data exchange between worker nodes

content.key_idea: Pheromone runs on a cluster where redundant Coordinators orchestrate multiple Worker Nodes, each running a Scheduler and Executors atop a local shared-memory object store, backed by a durable key-value store.
content.reading_order: top-down: Coordinators at top cross-connect into two Worker Nodes, each expanded to show its internal scheduler/executor/store stack, ending at the shared durable store at the bottom.

palette.used_for: Worker Node and Pheromone Runtime container backgrounds

style.stroke: thin dark outlines on boxes, dashed gray on the outer Pheromone Runtime and Worker Node containers
style.arrows: bidirectional black arrows, some crossing diagonally between Coordinators and Worker Nodes

encoding.color_means: each component role has its own flat fill: orange = Coordinator, green = Scheduler, yellow = Executor, light blue = object store, darker blue = durable store
encoding.emphasis: the crossing arrows between the two Coordinators and both Worker Nodes visually highlight the redundant, fully-connected coordination layer
reusable_patterns: two symmetric worker-node containers stacked over a shared bottom-layer durable store

evidence: Each worker node follows instructions from a local scheduler
A worker node also maintains a shared-memory object store

summary: Pheromone is a serverless function-orchestration system, rearchitected from Cloudburst, that orchestrates execution by following data rather than function calls. Figure 8 gives a whole-system architecture overview: at the top, redundant orange Coordinator instances cross-connect via bidirectional arrows to two Worker Node containers below them, illustrating that any coordinator can reach any worker. Each Worker Node is drawn as a gray dashed box holding a green Scheduler, one or more yellow Executors that load and run user function code, and a blue Shared Memory Object Store for intermediate data, with the object stores of different nodes linked to each other for fast exchange. At the bottom, a single wide blue Durable Key-Value Store box connects to both worker nodes, representing Pheromone's use of Anna as durable storage. The layered, top-down layout and consistent role-based color coding make the runtime's coordination and storage hierarchy easy to read at a glance.
